title: Classic Vegetable Stir-Fry
description: A quick and colorful stir-fry perfect for using up vegetables before they go bad.
steps: Chop all vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
Heat oil in a large pan or wok over high heat.
Add garlic and ginger, stir for 30 seconds.
Add harder vegetables (carrots, broccoli) first and stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add remaining vegetables and stir-fry 2 more minutes.
Drizzle soy sauce and toss to coat. Serve over rice.

title: Scrambled Eggs with Cheese
description: Creamy scrambled eggs — great when eggs and cheese are close to expiry.
steps: Crack eggs into a bowl, add a splash of milk, salt and pepper. Whisk.
Melt butter in a non-stick pan over medium-low heat.
Pour in egg mixture. Gently fold with a spatula as it cooks.
Remove from heat while still slightly wet — residual heat will finish cooking.
Top with shredded cheese and serve immediately.

title: Banana Oat Pancakes
description: Use up overripe bananas in these fluffy, naturally sweet pancakes.
steps: Mash 2 ripe bananas in a bowl until smooth.
Mix in 2 eggs, 1/2 cup milk, 1 cup oats, 1 tsp baking powder, and cinnamon.
Let batter rest 5 minutes so oats absorb liquid.
Heat a lightly oiled pan over medium heat.
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake; cook 2-3 min per side until golden.

title: Garlic Butter Pasta
description: A simple pasta dish perfect when you have butter, garlic, and any leftover vegetables.
steps: Cook pasta in salted boiling water according to package directions.
While pasta cooks, melt butter with olive oil in a large pan.
Add minced garlic and sauté 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Drain pasta, reserving 1/2 cup pasta water.
Toss pasta in garlic butter, adding pasta water as needed.
Top with parmesan and parsley.

title: Tomato Egg Drop Soup
description: A comforting Chinese-style soup that uses tomatoes and eggs in minutes.
steps: Dice tomatoes and beat eggs in a bowl.
Sauté garlic in a pot, then add tomatoes and cook 2 minutes.
Add broth and bring to a gentle boil.
Mix cornstarch with water and stir into soup to thicken slightly.
Slowly drizzle beaten eggs into simmering soup while stirring.
Finish with sesame oil and scallions.

title: Yogurt Parfait
description: Layer yogurt with fruit and granola for a fast breakfast or snack.
steps: Spoon yogurt into a glass or bowl.
Layer with fresh or slightly overripe berries or sliced banana.
Top with granola for crunch.
Drizzle honey and serve immediately.

title: Spinach & Feta Omelette
description: A protein-packed omelette — great for spinach that needs to be used up.
steps: Wilt spinach in a pan with garlic for 1-2 minutes; set aside.
Beat 2-3 eggs with salt and pepper.
Melt butter in pan over medium heat and pour in egg mixture.
When edges set, add spinach and crumbled feta to one half.
Fold omelette over and slide onto a plate.

title: Fried Rice with Leftovers
description: Transform leftover rice and any fridge vegetables into a satisfying fried rice.
steps: Use day-old cold rice for best results.
Scramble eggs in an oiled wok, then push to side.
Add garlic and onion, then diced carrots and peas.
Add rice and break up any clumps, stir-frying on high heat.
Drizzle soy sauce and sesame oil, toss well and serve.

title: Creamy Mushroom Toast
description: Sauté mushrooms in butter and cream for an indulgent toast topper.
steps: Slice mushrooms and mince garlic.
Melt butter in a pan and sauté mushrooms until golden, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and thyme, cook 1 minute.
Pour in a splash of cream and stir until slightly thickened.
Toast bread, spoon mushroom mixture on top, garnish with parsley.

title: Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal
description: Use up apples in a warm, filling breakfast bowl.
steps: Dice apple and sauté in butter with cinnamon for 3 minutes.
In a pot, bring milk to a simmer, add oats and cook 5 minutes, stirring.
Stir in vanilla and a pinch of salt.
Pour oatmeal into a bowl and top with caramelized apple.
Drizzle with honey before serving.

title: Avocado Toast
description: The classic — perfect when avocados are just ripe and need to be eaten.
steps: Toast bread to your preferred level.
Halve and pit the avocado, scoop flesh into a bowl.
Mash avocado with a fork, add lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Spread onto toast and sprinkle with chili flakes.
Optional: top with a fried egg or sliced tomato.

title: Potato & Onion Hash
description: Crispy pan-fried potatoes and onions — a hearty way to use up both before they sprout.
steps: Dice potatoes into small cubes (par-boil 5 min if needed to speed up cooking).
Slice onion thinly.
Heat oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add potatoes, press down and let cook undisturbed 5 minutes to crisp.
Stir, add onion and garlic, cook another 8 minutes until everything is golden.
Season with paprika, salt, and pepper.

title: Lemon Herb Chicken
description: A simple pan-seared chicken perfect for chicken that needs to be cooked today.
steps: Season chicken breasts with salt, pepper, and dried herbs.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Sear chicken 5-6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
In the last 2 minutes, add minced garlic and squeeze lemon over chicken.
Rest 5 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Cucumber Yogurt Salad
description: A refreshing salad using cucumber and yogurt — great as a side or snack.
steps: Dice or grate cucumber, sprinkle with salt, let sit 5 min to draw out water, then squeeze dry.
Mix yogurt with minced garlic, chopped dill, and a squeeze of lemon.
Fold in cucumber.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve chilled.

title: Berry Smoothie
description: Blend berries and yogurt for a fast nutritious drink before berries go soft.
steps: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend until smooth, about 30-60 seconds.
Taste and adjust sweetness with honey.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

title: Minestrone-Style Veggie Soup
description: A flexible, hearty soup for using multiple vegetables at once.
steps: Dice all vegetables into small cubes.
Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until softened.
Add carrots and celery, cook 3 minutes.
Add tomatoes, zucchini, and broth. Bring to a boil.
Add pasta and simmer 10 minutes until pasta is cooked.
Season with salt, pepper, and herbs. Serve with crusty bread.

title: Cheese Quesadilla
description: Melt cheese between tortillas with any leftover fillings for a quick meal.
steps: Dice bell pepper and onion, sauté briefly until softened.
Place a tortilla in a lightly buttered pan over medium heat.
Add shredded cheese and sautéed vegetables to one half.
Fold tortilla over and cook 2-3 minutes until golden.
Flip and cook another 1-2 minutes. Slice and serve with salsa.

title: Baked Potato
description: A perfectly simple baked potato — use up potatoes nearing their end.
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Scrub potato, pierce with a fork several times.
Rub with oil and salt, place directly on oven rack.
Bake 45-60 minutes until skin is crispy and inside is fluffy.
Cut open, top with butter, cheese, sour cream, and chives.

title: Sautéed Greens with Garlic
description: A fast side for any leafy greens — spinach, kale, or chard — before they wilt.
steps: Wash and dry greens, remove tough stems.
Heat olive oil in a wide pan over medium-high heat.
Add sliced garlic and chili flakes, sauté 1 minute.
Add greens in batches, tossing as they wilt.
Season with salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lemon.

title: French Toast
description: Use bread that's going stale and eggs before they expire for a classic breakfast.
steps: Whisk together eggs, milk, cinnamon, and vanilla in a shallow dish.
Dip each bread slice in the egg mixture, coating both sides.
Melt butter in a pan over medium heat.
Cook bread slices 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Serve with maple syrup, fresh fruit, or powdered sugar.
